result.summary: Implemented Offline Private Reality append-only journal with aidle_canonical_json_v1 serialization, SHA-256 entity/set hashes (HashingContext), idempotent request_id replay, optimistic expected_world_revision checks, compensation append linked to prior_receipt_id, cancel/preview gate, and fail-closed load for truncated/malformed/incompatible schema / wrong space_type. G3 base revision 3 preserved through save/reload. Headless G4_PERSIST_SMOKE=PASS checks=11 exit 0; AIDLE_VALIDATION=PASS.

in_scope: Local/offline Private Reality simulation durability only
out_of_scope: Server World Commit live service, economy, marketplace

explicit_not: claim that local journal IS online World Commit truth

implementation.canonical_serialization: aidle_canonical_json_v1 — sorted object keys, compact JSON, float max 6 frac digits strip trailing zeros
implementation.entity_hash: SHA-256 via HashingContext over canonical entity record (lowercase 64 hex)
implementation.entity_set_hash: SHA-256 of sorted active entity array (tombstones excluded)

journal_envelope.storage: single JSON document; atomic temp+replace save

implementation.idempotency: request_id key; duplicate returns idempotent_replay with prior_receipt_id; no second entity/revision/entry
implementation.revision: expected_world_revision must equal head or conflicted revision_mismatch; zero partial mutation
implementation.compensation: new append with prior_receipt_id, history_erased=false; never deletes history
implementation.cancel_gate: receipt_kind=cancel / preview_only / confirmation.state!=confirmed rejected; never journaled

commands.log_notes: No SCRIPT ERROR / Parse Error / Compile Error / ERROR: lines. Autoload boot lines only (EventBus, ArtStyleManager, ModuleRegistry, GameManager).

self_audit.bootstrap_limitation: E:\scripts\bootstrap-agent-session.ps1 known parser error near line 52; not retried; loaded Agents.md, ARCHITECTURE_LOCK, WO-G4-001, G4-001_DISPATCH_MAP, P0_schema, G3 complete receipt, agent_step_contract manually

remaining_risks: Optional integrity chain hash not implemented (entry_count + revision chain validation on load covers MVP fail-closed)
Local journal apply is Private Reality simulation only; executor consumer verify (P2) must not treat it as world_commit_service authority
Float formatter edge cases beyond tested 8.0/8.5/0.12 — grid-aligned ints preferred in entity records
PersistModule not yet wired into main scene mount tree (API + smoke ready; P3 core may verify boot integration)
